entities.summary: Srinivasa Iyer Ramaswamy, better known as Cho Ramaswamy, was an Indian actor, comedian, editor, political commentator, satirist, playwright, film director and lawyer from Tamil Nadu. He was a popular comedian in the 1960s and 1970s, and had acted with all the top stars in that period.
